requirements.name: Lessons Learned
requirements.action: Complete Lessons Learned by finding all 14 lost golemancer recordings in Draconis Mons.

objectives.name: Zinn's first recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's first recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's first recording in Heathen's Hold. Near the prison north of the Mercenary Encampment; descend the hidden ramp behind the lantern.

objectives.name: Zinn's second recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's second recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's second recording in Rata Arcanum. Use the northern thermal tube toward Gate of Fire; the recording is on a concealed ledge/tunnel route.

objectives.name: Zinn's third recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's third recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's third recording in Rata Arcanum. Head toward the Rata Arcanum vista, then glide west into a small hole.

objectives.name: Zinn's fourth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's fourth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's fourth recording in Heathen's Hold. Use the metal ramps from Wurm's Furnace and follow the wall southeast into a small hole.

objectives.name: Zinn's fifth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's fifth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's fifth recording in Heathen's Hold. Use the metal ramps from Wurm's Furnace; the recorder is behind the tent beneath three copper pipes.

objectives.name: Zinn's sixth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's sixth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's sixth recording in Blistering Abyss. Reach the upper ledges via gliding/Oakheart movement and find the small webbed cave.

objectives.name: Zinn's seventh recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's seventh recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's seventh recording in Ancient Hollow. Head northeast and reach the elevated blue-lit cave using Oakheart's Reach or a skyscale.

objectives.name: Zinn's eighth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's eighth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's eighth recording in Rata Arcanum. Use thermal tubes and Oakheart's Reach to enter the cave, then reach the upper southwest ledge.

objectives.name: Zinn's ninth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's ninth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's ninth recording in Heathen's Hold. Glide below the waypoint toward the plateau, then use Oakheart's Reach into the small crevice.

objectives.name: Zinn's tenth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's tenth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's tenth recording in Ancient Hollow. Head a short distance northwest and drop into the small opening near the corner.

objectives.name: Zinn's eleventh recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's eleventh recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's eleventh recording in Savage Rise. Reach the bristleback area and use Oakheart's Reach toward the small cave at the north end.

objectives.name: Zinn's twelfth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's twelfth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's twelfth recording in Heathen's Hold. Enter Iota Vault and use Oakheart's Reach inside the right-hand cage to reach the ledge.

objectives.name: Zinn's thirteenth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's thirteenth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's thirteenth recording in Savage Rise. Reach the Oakheart Essence near the rockface and enter the nearby cave/crevice.

objectives.name: Zinn's fourteenth recording
objectives.text: Recover Zinn's fourteenth recording.
objectives.action: Recover Zinn's fourteenth recording in Scalding Gorge. Reach the mushroom cave/upper ledge route and enter the cave containing the recorder.

combine.action: Combine Sentient Anomaly, Sentient Aberration, Sentient Oddity, and Sentient Singularity in the Mystic Forge.

purchase.action: Use Gleam of Sentience to purchase the Sentient Seed for 1,000 Unbound Magic.
